name: Suzuka Hills Circuit
localName: 鈴鹿ヒルズ・サーキット
inspiration: Inspired by the figure-eight circuit at Suzuka, Mie, Japan (5.8 km, crossover bridge, S-Curves, Degner, Hairpin, Spoon, 130R). The lap follows the real layout traced from OpenStreetMap with real elevation; corner nicknames are kept, sponsor-named corners use generic names. Buildings, grandstands, the amusement-park wheel and all branding are original. No real venue, event, series or sponsor branding.

source.centreline: OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0), ways tagged highway=raceway, chained and smoothed (σ 4 m)
source.elevation: SRTM-based terrarium DEM (Mapzen/AWS open terrain tiles), smoothed (σ 30 m), crossover carved to 8.5 m clearance
source.landcover: classified from a satellite reference + OSM water/buildings/solar; regenerate with suzuka/terrain.py

coords: World X = east, Y = up (metres above sea level), Z = -north. Origin 34.8431 N, 136.5407 E. Lap direction: home straight → Turn 1 (clockwise half) → crossover (under) → Hairpin → Spoon → back straight over the bridge (anticlockwise half) → 130R → Final Chicane.

spline.note: points[0] = exit of the Final Chicane. Elevation in Y. The spline crosses itself in plan at the crossover: use t (not XZ nearest-point) for progress, and the Y of the spline to know which deck a car is on.

notes: Home straight falls ~25 m to Turn 1 (lowest point)
Hairpin → Spoon: highest part of the lap (~58 m)
Back straight descends gently over the bridge to 130R

bridge.note: deck top = road. Collision: treat the two decks as separate layers by spline t; the lower road passes between the abutments.

terrain.note: Height = (R*256+G)/65535 * 160 - 10 m, 4 m/px, 1050×825 over x −2400…1800, north −1500…1800. Landcover R forest, G paddy, B built-up, A = 255 − water. Corridor already flattened under the road (0.35 m below).

corners.name: Turn 1 / Turn 2
corners.note: Downhill braking from 300+ km/h; the classic first-lap pile-up.

corners.name: S-Curves
corners.note: Rhythm section uphill — miss one apex and the whole sequence falls apart.

corners.name: Reverse Bank
corners.note: Banked the wrong way; tempting to run wide onto the kerb.

corners.name: Hill Curve
corners.note: Long uphill left onto the short run to Degner.

corners.name: Degner 1
corners.note: Narrow and fast with gravel close on the exit.

corners.name: Degner 2
corners.note: Brake and turn; leads under the bridge.

corners.name: Crossover (under)
corners.note: Pass beneath the back straight. Cars above you are on the other half of the lap.

corners.name: Hairpin
corners.note: Slowest corner (≈ 60 km/h). Best overtaking spot on the lap.

corners.name: 200R
corners.note: Flat in the fast cars on the climb to Spoon.

corners.name: Spoon
corners.note: Long double-apex left onto the back straight — exit speed is everything.

corners.name: Back Straight + bridge
corners.note: 1 km flat out, slipstream and nitro territory; crosses over the Degner road.

corners.name: 130R
corners.note: Flat-out left at the bottom of the back straight. Commitment corner.

corners.name: Final Chicane
corners.note: Heavy braking, last chance to pass before the line.

kerbs.note: inside of every corner (|curvature| > 1.6°/12 m) + outside at exits; red/white

runoff.where: outside of corners: 4 m asphalt strip then gravel trap

landmarks.name: Amusement-park wheel (52 m)
landmarks.note: visible from the home straight, Turn 1 and the Final Chicane; LED rim glows at dusk

landmarks.name: Main grandstand + pit building + control tower

vegetation.rule: placements.trees already filtered from the landcover forest mask (≈ 1 per 36 m² within 450 m of the track, thinning outwards); colour patches = maple/zelkova clusters, cedar/camphor in the cool valleys, ginkgo avenues along main roads. InstancedMesh per model, random yaw, scale 0.75–1.25.

surroundings.note: roads (draped ribbons, width per type), car parks, ponds (flat water at the lowest bank height), larger buildings (extrude footprints; small ones are already house models in placements), monorail beams, power lines (pylons in placements).

ambience.where: home straight / Turn 1 / chicane, within 500 m of the wheel

events.when: each car passing under the bridge (positional)

sun.note: low WSW sun: blinding into 130R and the back straight, backlit autumn trees in the S-Curves

lighting.backdrop: textures/suzuka_mountains.png on an 11 km cylinder (Suzuka range W/NW); Ise Bay sea plane from x = 5.5 km east

armco.note: Added for the game: the invisible side walls stand where most of the Armco does (median 16.3 m from the centre line); the placements draw the barriers themselves. Marks the map as a circuit (no generic sidewalk strip).
